description: Hash-anchored source extracts for class-based NPC creation (NPC_MODE_PLAN.md Phase 0). Anchors the locally available Core Rulebook content, curates fragments consumed by the NPC catalog builders, and records exactly which source domains are missing locally.

extraction.note: Fragment line ranges are stable because the parent .txt files are immutable. core-rulebook-extract.txt line numbers depend on this exact pdftotext version; the extract itself is hash-anchored so downstream code never re-runs extraction.

core-rulebook-pdf.description: 16-page Core Rulebook PDF excerpt: complete class spell lists (Bard 0-6, Cleric 0-9, Druid 0-9, Paladin 1-4, Ranger 1-4, Sorcerer/Wizard 0-9) plus the first alphabetical spell descriptions. This is the ONLY local Core Rulebook content; NPC creation pages 448-454, races, class tables, skills, feats, equipment, and Appendix gear tables are not present.

core-rulebook-txt-legacy.description: Existing 1749-line extraction of the 16-page spell excerpt; anchored by catalog/catalog.json as pathfinder-core-txt. Must not be modified.

pathfinder-unchained-txt.description: Existing full Simple Monster Creation chapter (5566 lines); anchored by catalog/catalog.json as pathfinder-unchained-txt. Must not be modified.

bestiary-txt.description: Existing 2-page Bestiary appendix: Table 1-1 (Monster Statistics by CR) and Table 1-2 (Creature Hit Dice by CR); anchored by catalog/catalog.json as bestiary-txt.

npc-mode-plan.description: Local implementation plan; the only local carrier of the printed Kiramor statblock values.

core-rulebook-extract.contents: Complete spell-list chapter for Bard (0-6), Cleric (0-9), Druid (0-9), Paladin (1-4), Ranger (1-4), Sorcerer/Wizard (0-9), followed by the opening of the alphabetical spell descriptions (roughly the letter A: Acid Fog, Acid Splash, Air Walker, Astral Projection, Energy Drain, Etherealness, Shapechange, Soul Bind, Time Stop, Wail of the Banshee, Wish). Two-column PDF; reading order is reliable in the list section, partially scrambled in the description section.
core-rulebook-extract.catalogUse: NPC spell lists (adept = cleric/druid lists; PC casters) for tasks 3.b and 5.a.

core-rulebook-extract-spell-lists.contents: Spell-list portion only: complete class lists for Bard (0-6), Cleric (0-9), Druid (0-9), Paladin (1-4), Ranger (1-4), and Sorcerer/Wizard (0-9), ending immediately before the alphabetical spell-description section. Two-column extraction losses: the cleric 7th-level and druid 3rd-level lists are empty in the excerpt at page boundaries; the parser records them as emptySections.
core-rulebook-extract-spell-lists.catalogUse: Stable parse target for spell list membership in the NPC catalog (tools/parse_npc_sources.py).

pathfinder-unchained-npc-likeness.contents: Simple Monster Creation guidance that a monster meant to be more like an NPC, especially one using a PC race, should avoid monstrous combat options.
pathfinder-unchained-npc-likeness.catalogUse: Policy grounding: NPC-likeness expectations and the future Simple Monster comparison benchmark (plan section 13).

bestiary-table-1-1.contents: Bestiary Table 1-1: Monster Statistics by CR (CR 1/2 through 20 rows).
bestiary-table-1-1.catalogUse: Future draft.compareBenchmarks comparisons (plan section 13); never used to compute NPC statistics.

core-rulebook-npc-creation-pages.needed: Before You Begin, Steps 1-7 workflow, basic/heroic arrays, statblockUse rules
core-rulebook-npc-creation-pages.reason: Local Core Rulebook PDF is a 16-page spell excerpt only.
core-rulebook-npc-creation-pages.consequence: Workflow text and any numeric rule printed on these pages is an explicit catalog gap until a hash-anchored copy is added.

core-rulebook-races.needed: Seven Core races with ability adjustments, sizes, speeds, senses, traits, languages
core-rulebook-races.consequence: Racial data is a catalog gap; the engine must reject races it cannot anchor.

core-rulebook-class-tables.needed: Five NPC classes (adept, aristocrat, commoner, expert, warrior) and eleven PC classes through level 20: BAB, saves, HD, skill points, feature grants, choice slots, spells per day
core-rulebook-class-tables.consequence: Class level rows are a catalog gap; no class table row may be built from memory.

core-rulebook-advancement.needed: Character advancement, Table 3-2 experience, +1 ability increase every four levels, multiclass rules
core-rulebook-advancement.consequence: The level-4/8/12/16/20 ability-increase rule is a catalog gap pending an anchored extract.

core-rulebook-skills.needed: Skill list, class skills, Armor Check Penalty, rank limits
core-rulebook-skills.consequence: Skill catalog rows are a catalog gap.

core-rulebook-feats.needed: Core feat list, prerequisite prose, general feat progression (1, 3, 5, 7, 9...), class bonus feats
core-rulebook-feats.consequence: Feat catalog rows and typed prerequisites are a catalog gap.

core-rulebook-equipment.needed: Weapons, armor, goods, magic item prices (integer copper), Table 14-9 NPC gear budgets, gear profiles (slow/medium/fast, low/normal/high fantasy)
core-rulebook-equipment.consequence: Gear budgets and item prices are catalog gaps; nothing may be priced from memory.

core-rulebook-spell-descriptions.needed: Full spell descriptions for levels/DCs/components beyond the letter-A fragment
core-rulebook-spell-descriptions.consequence: Spell list membership is locally anchored; per-spell rules beyond the fragment remain a catalog gap.

kiramor-statblock.needed: The printed 'Kiramor, the Forest Shadow' example statblock
kiramor-statblock.consequence: Printed Kiramor values exist only in NPC_MODE_PLAN.md section 12; treated as unanchored until a hash-anchored source is added. See docs/kiramor-worksheet.md.
